program_name: Apple One (1) Year Limited Warranty (iPhone, iPad, iPod, Apple TV, HomePod, Apple Vision Pro; U.S.)
coverage_summary: iPhone (including iPhone 18 Pro), iPad, iPod, Apple TV, HomePod and Apple Vision Pro bought in the U.S., for faults in the first year
coverage: Defects in materials and workmanship when used normally in accordance with Apple's published guidelines, for one year from the date of original retail purchase by the end-user purchaser
remedy: At Apple's option: repair, replacement with the same model (or with your consent a substantially similar product), or a refund of the purchase price
mandatory_conditions: The claim is submitted to Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider during the one-year Warranty Period
The fault is a defect in materials or workmanship, with the product used normally in line with Apple's published guidelines
Apple or its agents may require proof of purchase details and may ask diagnostic questions before service
Back up the device first: the storage is erased during warranty service
exclusions_and_caveats: Not covered: damage caused by accident, abuse, misuse, fire, liquid contact, earthquake or other external cause
Not covered: cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, broken plastic on ports) and batteries or coatings that diminish over time, unless the failure is due to a defect in materials or workmanship
Not covered: damage from service by anyone other than Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider, or a product modified without Apple's written permission
Not covered: defects caused by normal wear and tear or normal aging
Apple may restrict warranty service for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, HomePod and Apple Vision Pro to the country where the device was originally sold
This is the U.S. version of Apple's warranty. Other countries have their own version, and consumer law may give you further rights
